title: Multiplicative score breakdown
acceptance: The layout reads as a multiplication, not as a list of nine independent bars.
A single zero factor is visibly fatal to the result and is named in words.
Inert factors render marked as not measured rather than being hidden.
A mismatch between the supplied total and the computed product is surfaced, never swallowed.
Factor descriptions are reachable by keyboard, not hover only.
Product, band classification, and running-product sequence are exported pure functions with tests covering zero, all-ones, epsilon mismatch, and empty input.
